decisions.decision: Create a clean single-purpose branch named matching-layer containing only the files used by the current general Matching runtime, contracts, receipts and validation suite.
decisions.source: User direction in the current turn.
decisions.scope: djtoler/astra-visual-selector branch organization and active Matching implementation authority; no rendering or template selection.
decisions.reason: The validated implementation was mixed with historical selector, intake, treatment and calibration artifacts. A dependency-derived orphan branch provides one uncluttered authority without deleting prior history.

decisions.decision: Use matching-layer as the active Matching workspace and retain codex/general-matching-layer-v12 only as frozen publication provenance.
decisions.source: User direction to update active memory after branch extraction.
decisions.scope: Future Matching code, contracts, receipts, tests, task reconciliation and repository monitoring.
decisions.reason: A single explicit implementation authority prevents work from drifting back into the mixed historical branch.

decisions.decision: Preserve the user-owned replacement-selection review file and all excluded historical files on their existing branches rather than copying or deleting them.
decisions.source: Workspace ownership and extraction safety review.
decisions.scope: Files outside the dependency-derived matching-layer manifest.
decisions.reason: The workflow requires preservation of scoped review state and forbids silent substitutions; branch extraction does not authorize deleting historical or user-owned files.
